pr_title: Replace wrong domain returned from xbox api

## Proposed change
<!--

  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug

As explained in [this issue-807727457](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/46486#issue-807727457) the xbox api somehow returns a wrong domain sometimes. The wrong url is: "https://images-eds.xboxlive.com/" and it contains a wrong certificate (common name invalid). However, if you replace the domain with: "https://images-eds-ssl.xboxlive.com/" there is no certificate error and the correct image is loaded. 

To fix this, the base_sensor can do a string replace. if the wrong url is returned, it is replaced with the correct one. If the xbox api returns the correct one already, nothing is replaced. 

**I don't have the means or knowhow to test this, as its a simple change, i'm hoping someone can test this or help me test this **

**The problem**

The xbox integration (not xbox-live) sometimes loads the wrong gamertag images. some gamertag images are loaded over https://images-eds.xboxlive.com/ in stead of https://images-eds-ssl.xboxlive.com/. the one without -ssl gets a certificate error and thus images are not loaded.

this means that, in my case, two images are not loades, while the other two are loaded.

I'm familiar with python, and i think i found an easy fix, but i'm not sure if it's something that's allowed or desirable:

The issue is that for some accounts the api returns a non ssl url, while the ssl url does work. All you have to do is replace "images-eds" with "images-eds-ssl". So you could do the following:

In the [base_sensory.py](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/homeassistant/components/xbox/base_sensor.py) the url is set for the base sensor (and my guess is you use that for all other entitities?). on line 47, you could add a replace function like this:

old:
```python
return self.data.display_pic.replace("&mode=Padding", "")
```
new:
```python
return self.data.display_pic.replace("&mode=Padding", "").replace("images-eds.xboxlive.com", "images-eds-ssl.xboxlive.com")
```

That way, if an non ssl url is served, it is replaced by an ssl url. 

Hope this helps.
